S18.01.needs: a Free account or a paid account
S18.01.note: Title is set on the server in persist-message.ts; the chat header title button has aria-label 'Conversation options' (ConversationTitleMenu.tsx). No visible control was found.
steps: Start a new chat, send one message, and wait for the reply.
Look at the chat header title and the sidebar row for this conversation.
Check that the title is a short name based on the message, not 'New chat' or blank.

S18.02.note: The sidebar row menu also has Rename (packages/ui/ui/src/sidebar/SessionItem.tsx). Escape cancels the rename.
steps: Open a conversation that already has a title.
Click the title at the top of the chat.
Choose Rename, type a new name, and press Enter.
Reload the page and check the new name is still shown in the header and sidebar.
S18.02.where: Chat header > conversation title (button named 'Conversation options') > Rename

S18.03.note: The row menu is not shown in the 'simple' sidebar mode (SessionItem.tsx checks !simple).
steps: Hover a conversation row in the sidebar and click its More options button.
Click Pin.
Check the conversation moves to the top of the list.
Open its More options again and click Unpin.
Check it returns to its normal place.
S18.03.where: Sidebar > conversation row > More options for [conversation name] > Pin (then Unpin)

S18.04.note: The restore item from the sidebar row menu is shown as an icon (ArchiveRestore) in SessionItem.tsx; its text was not confirmed.
steps: Open a conversation, click its title, and choose Archive.
Check it disappears from the main sidebar list.
Open the sidebar filter labelled Archived (count) and find the conversation.
Open its menu and choose Unarchive, then check it is back in the main list.
S18.04.where: Chat header > conversation title (Conversation options) > Archive; restore from Sidebar > Archived ({count}) > the conversation > Unarchive

S18.05.needs: a test conversation you can delete
S18.05.note: The menu item calls onDelete directly; the confirmation step was not found in the menu file, so check the handler before judging it. Sidebar row menu also has Delete (SessionItem.tsx).
steps: Open a test conversation and click its title.
Choose Delete.
Check whether a confirmation appears before anything is removed.
Confirm, then check the conversation is gone from the sidebar and the Archived list.
S18.05.where: Chat header > conversation title (Conversation options) > Delete

S18.06.note: The visible word is 'Duplicate as branch', not 'Duplicate'. The item shows only when the fork handler is passed (onFork).
steps: Open a conversation with several messages.
Click its title and choose Duplicate as branch.
Check a new conversation opens with the same messages.
Send a message in one conversation and check the other does not change.
S18.06.where: Chat header > conversation title (Conversation options) > Duplicate as branch

S18.07.note: The menu item only appears when projects exist. The sidebar row menu also has Move to project (SessionItem.tsx).
steps: Make sure at least one project exists.
Open a conversation that is not in a project and click its title.
Choose Move to project and pick a project name.
Open the project and check the conversation is listed there.
S18.07.where: Chat header > conversation title (Conversation options) > Move to project (shows Change project when already in a project)

S18.09.needs: an account that can use Work mode
S18.09.note: The buttons are disabled while a reply is running. Switching to Chat clears the project and working folder (ChatComposerNew.tsx).
steps: Open a conversation in Chat mode, or start a new chat.
Click Work in the composer mode buttons and check it becomes pressed.
Send a task and check the Work session panel opens for later turns.
Click Chat and check the mode switches back.
S18.09.where: Composer > Work or Chat mode buttons (Work is shown when the account can use Work mode)

labels.text: Stays out of your history, search, memory and Library.

S18.10.note: The trigger is named only by its aria-label 'More composer options'. The temporary rows show only when showTemporaryChat is set.
steps: Open a conversation and click More composer options.
Read the line under the temporary chat row: 'Stays out of your history, search, memory and Library.'
Click Use incognito and check the row changes to Exit incognito.
Check the chat is marked temporary, and send a message to see it is kept out of history.
S18.10.where: Composer > More composer options (plus button) > Use incognito (shows Exit incognito when on)

S18.11.note: The shortcut is Command+F on Mac (metaKey); it is set in ChatMessageList.tsx.
steps: Open a conversation with several messages.
Press Command+F.
Type a word that appears in the conversation.
Check the matching messages are highlighted and the search box stays open. Press Escape to close it.
S18.11.where: Open a conversation > press Command+F > Search messages box

S18.12.needs: a conversation with several matches for one word
S18.12.note: These are icon buttons with aria-labels; the visible text is not shown.
steps: Open search with Command+F and type a word with several matches.
Click Go to next match and check the transcript scrolls to the next match.
Click Go to previous match and check it goes back.
Compare the position with the match count shown in the search bar.
S18.12.where: Open a conversation > Command+F > type a word > Go to next match / Go to previous match buttons

S18.15.needs: a conversation long enough to scroll
S18.15.note: It is an icon button with an aria-label; no visible text.
steps: Open a conversation with many messages.
Scroll up to an older message.
Click the Scroll to bottom button that appears.
Check the view jumps to the latest message.
S18.15.where: Open a long conversation > scroll up > Scroll to bottom button

S18.17.needs: a conversation that already has branches
S18.17.note: How a user creates a branch (onBranch in MessageBubble.tsx) has no visible label found yet.
steps: Open a conversation that has branches.
Find a message with the branch control under it.
Click Next branch, then Previous branch.
Check the n/total count and the shown messages change to match the branch.
S18.17.where: Chat transcript > a message with branches > Previous branch / Next branch arrows with the n/total count

S18.18.note: The format choices (Markdown, PDF, JSON) were not found in the menu file; check the export handler in WebChatPage.tsx before judging them.
steps: Open a conversation with several messages.
Click its title and choose Export….
Choose the format in the export step and save or download the file.
Open the file and check all messages, the title and the timestamps are there.
S18.18.where: Chat header > conversation title (Conversation options) > Export…

S18.19.needs: a test conversation and an account allowed to share
S18.19.note: Creating a link makes a public URL; only do it on a test conversation.
steps: Open a conversation that has messages.
Click Share conversation.
Read the read-only snapshot note and the access and expiry choices (1, 7 or 30 days).
Create a link only with a test conversation, then check the link appears.
S18.19.where: Chat header > Share conversation button (or Conversation options > Share…)

S18.20.note: Revoked links cannot be restored, and the dialog says a new link can still be created.
steps: Open Share conversation on a conversation that has a live link.
Find the link in the Conversation link field.
Click Revoke share or Revoke every link and read the confirmation.
Confirm, then open the link in a private window and check it no longer works.
S18.20.where: Chat header > Share conversation > Revoke share (or Revoke every link)

S18.21.note: The exact rows in the Details section were not confirmed in the code read.
steps: Open a conversation and open the chat details panel with the Open Chat details control.
Find the Details section.
Compare the shown rows with the expected: created and updated time, model, message count, id and project.
S18.21.where: Chat header or Work session panel > Open Chat details (or Close Chat details) > Details

S18.22.needs: a Work conversation with a run
S18.22.note: Instructions, memory and token budget were not found in these dock sections; only tools and files were confirmed.
steps: In an AGI Work conversation, open the session dock.
Find the Context section and read the tools and files it lists.
Find the Sources section and check its entries.
Compare with Expected: files, instructions, memory and token budget.
S18.22.where: Open the session dock (Open ... session dock) > Context, Sources sections

S18.25.note: Toggles are stored per conversation (composerTogglesByConversation in WebChatPage.tsx); the Web search toggle's own row was not found in the plus menu.
steps: Open a conversation and set Deep Research or Web search on from the composer.
Send a message and read the reply.
Send a second message and check the same tool is still on in this conversation.
Open another conversation and check its tools are separate.
S18.25.where: Composer > More composer options > Deep Research (and the Web search and Run code toggles)

S18.26.note: A 'Connectors' row exists in ComposerPlusMenu.tsx but renders as a coming-soon item (line 1776); the per-conversation disabledConnectorIds is passed at WebChatPage.tsx near line 2763, with no visible picker found. Searched for the conversation connector picker in apps/web/features/chat and found none.

S18.27.needs: a Work conversation with an active run
S18.27.note: The task list code at WorkSessionPanel.tsx line 295 was not verified in this read.
steps: Start a Work task from a conversation.
Open the session dock.
Find the Progress section and check the task's status matches what the run shows.
S18.27.where: Open the session dock (Open ... session dock) > Progress

S18.28.needs: a second browser or device signed in to the same account
S18.28.note: Cross-device sync is the server's job (persist-message.ts), shown in the sidebar (SessionItem.tsx); no separate control found.
steps: Sign in to the same account in a second browser or device.
Open the sidebar there and find the conversation started on the first device.
Send a message from the second device and check it appears on the first after a reload.
